codexSidebar.defaultProvider.description: Default provider used by the chat input.

codexSidebar.parserMode.description: Streaming parser mode. Use legacy for quick rollback if parsing regression occurs.

codexSidebar.showToolUsageIndicator.description: Show tool usage count in the Thinking Process summary and highlight it when tools were used.

codexSidebar.codexThinkingNoiseFilterEna.description: Filter low-value Codex thinking lines (e.g. Planning/Preparing headings) before rendering.

codexSidebar.codexAutoResumeSession.description: Automatically resume the previous Codex exec session for follow-up requests.

codexSidebar.codexEnforceCheckpointPolic.description: Inject a system policy asking Codex to create a checkpoint before file edits.

codexSidebar.codexRequireHardCheckpoint.description: Create a real workspace snapshot checkpoint before every Codex request and block execution when checkpoint creation fails.

codexSidebar.codexHardCheckpointRetentio.description: Maximum number of hard checkpoint snapshots kept in extension global storage.

scripts.check:strict: npm run lint && npm run compile && npm run test && npm run security:check
